breakdown.description: The flow is labeled critical while the provided depth/velocity correspond to a Froude number far from 1.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the contradictory depth (y = 1.0 m) and velocity (V = 0.5 m/s) values and explicitly says 'Assume the flow is critical despite the low Froude number,' which perpetuates the inconsistency rather than resolving it. The ground truth removes these erroneous values entirely and simply asks to compute critical depth from q using yc = (q^2/g)^(1/3).
